command.log.openInNewWindow: Open Log in a Separate Window
command.diff.previousChange: Previous Change (Continuing into the Previous File)
command.diff.nextChange: Next Change (Continuing into the Next File)
command.diff.openCurrent: Open the Current Version for Editing
command.blame.lineInLog: Show the Commit of the Line in the Log
command.gitlab.disconnect: Remove the GitLab Token from Kleio…
capabilities.untrusted: Kleio runs git, and git runs the hooks and config of the repository.
capabilities.virtual: Kleio works with git in local folders.
config.codeLens.authors: Show the author of most lines and the number of other authors above classes and methods (as code vision in Rider).
config.history.showDiffOnSelect: Show the diff of the selected commit in the next editor group of a history tab right away.
config.autolinks: Rules turning text of commit messages into links: a regular expression and a URL with `$0` (the whole match) and `$1`… (groups). For example, `{"pattern": "PROJ-\\d+", "url": "https://tracker.example.com/issue/$0"}`. Set it in `.vscode/settings.json` of the repository to share the rule with the team. Links to GitLab and GitHub merge requests (`!12`) and issues (`#12`) are added by themselves.
config.hosting.instances: Hosting type of your own servers when Kleio does not detect it: `{"git.example.com": "gitlab"}`. github.com and gitlab.com are known; a GitLab server is usually detected by its merge request refs.
config.update.method: How Update Project brings the current branch up to its upstream when it has own commits. Without own commits the branch is simply moved forward (fast-forward).
config.push.protectedBranches: Branches on the server that are never force-pushed. `*` works, e.g. `release/*`.
config.worktree.path: Folder of a new worktree for "Checkout into a new worktree…". `${repoParent}` is the folder holding the main folder of the repository, `${repoName}` is its name, `${branch}` is the branch name (`/` becomes `-`). The path can be edited before the worktree is created.
config.worktree.copyFiles: Files copied from the main folder into a new worktree: what git does not keep but the project needs to run, e.g. `.env.local`. Paths are relative to the repository root.
config.hosting.backgroundRefresh: Ask the server for merge request refs (`git ls-remote`) every few minutes as the log refreshes. Turn it off if the server asks for the SSH key password every time: then the refs are asked for when the log opens and after a fetch.
config.commit.stagingArea: The commit view works with the git index (staging area), as `git commit` and the built-in Git of VS Code do: the checkboxes show and change what is staged, and the commit takes what is staged. Off, it works as in Rider: checked files and hunks are committed as they are on disk, and the index is not used. Also toggled by the Stage checkbox in the commit view.
config.autolinks.url: The link URL: `$0` is the match, `$1`… are the groups.
config.update.method.ask: Ask on the first update and remember the answer
config.update.method.merge: Incoming commits are merged with a merge commit, as git pull does
config.update.method.rebase: Own commits are rebased on top of the incoming ones, as git pull --rebase does
config.language: Language of Kleio: `auto` follows the display language of the editor; `en`, `ru` or another language with a translation in `l10n/` works without a language pack. Commands and settings follow the editor. Takes effect after the window is reloaded.
config.statusBar.branch: Show the current branch with ↑↓ in the status bar; a click opens the branches and the common actions, as the branch widget of Rider.
